import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class edge {
        int from, to;
        int cap, flow;
        edge(int from, int to, int cap, int flow) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static class PushRelabel {
        int N;
        ArrayList<edge> edges;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> G;
        int[] h, inQ, count;
        int[] excess;
        Queue<Integer> Q;
        PushRelabel(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            count = new int[N << 1];
            G = new ArrayList<>(N);
            h = new int[N];
            inQ = new int[N];
            excess = new int[N];
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                G.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            Q = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        int addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            G.get(from).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new edge(from, to, cap));
            G.get(to).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new edge(to, from, 0));
            return G.get(from).size() - 1;
        }

        void enQueue(int u) {
            if (!inQ[u] && excess[u] > 0) {
                Q.add(u);
                inQ[u] = true;
            }
        }

        void Push(int edgeIdx) {
            edge e = edges.get(edgeIdx);
            int toPush = Math.min(e.cap - e.flow, excess[e.from]);
            if (toPush > 0 && h[e.from] > h[e.to]) {
                e.flow += toPush;
                excess[e.to] += toPush;
                excess[e.from] -= toPush;
                edges.get(edgeIdx ^ 1).flow -= toPush;
                enQueue(e.to);
            }
        }

        void Relabel(int u) {
            count[h[u]] -= 1;
            h[u] = 2 * N - 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < G.get(u).size(); i++) {
                edge e = edges.get(G.get(u).get(i));
                if (e.cap > e.flow) h[u] = Math.min(h[u], h[e.to]);
            }
            count[++h[u]] += 1;
        }

        void gapRelabel(int height) {
            for (int u = 0; u < N; u++) {
                if (h[u] >= height && h[u] < N) {
                    count[h[u]] -= 1;
                    count[h[u] = N] += 1;
                    enQueue(u);
                }
            }
        }

        void Discharge(int u) {
            for (int i = 0; excess[u] > 0 && i < G.get(u).size(); i++) {
                Push(G.get(u).get(i));
            }
            if (excess[u] > 0) {
                if (h[u] < N && count[h[u]] < 2) gapRelabel(h[u]);
                else Relabel(u);
            } else if (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                Q.poll();
                inQ[u] = false;
            }
        }

        int getFlow(int src, int snk) {
            h[src] = N;
            inQ[src] = inQ[snk] = true;
            count[0] = N - (count[N] = 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < G.get(src).size(); i++) {
                excess[src] += edges.get(G.get(src).get(i)).cap;
                Push(G.get(src).get(i));
            }
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                Discharge(Q.peek());
            }
            return excess[snk];
        }
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        FastScanner() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        double nextDouble() {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }

        String nextLine() {
            String str = "";
            try {
                str = br.readLine();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return str;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner();
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int N = 20 + 5;
        int oo = 1e4 + 7;
        int[][] dis = new int[N][N];
        String[] s = new String[N];
        String[] t = new String[N];
        int n = fs.nextInt();
        int k = fs.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s[i] = fs.next();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            t[i] = fs.next();
        }
        int x = -1, y = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (t[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    x = i;
                    y = j;
                }
            }
        }
        bfs(x, y);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                dis[i][j] = dis[i][j] == -1 ? oo : dis[i][j];
            }
        }
        ArrayList<pii> source = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<pii> sink = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = s[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Z') continue;
                if (c == 'Y') continue;
                if (c == '0') continue;
                source.add(new pii(i, j));
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = t[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Z') continue;
                if (c == 'Y') continue;
                if (c == '0') continue;
                sink.add(new pii(i, j));
            }
        }
        PushRelabel g = new PushRelabel(source.size() + sink.size() + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < source.size(); i++) {
            g.addEdge(0, i + 1, s[source.get(i).first].charAt(source.get(i).second) - '0');
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sink.size(); i++) {
            g.addEdge(source.size() + i + 1, source.size() + sink.size() + 1, t[sink.get(i).first].charAt(sink.get(i).second) - '0');
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < source.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sink.size(); j++) {
                if (pos(0, source.get(i).first, source.get(i).second, sink.get(j).first, sink.get(j).second)) {
                    g.addEdge(i + 1, source.size() + j + 1, oo);
                }
            }
        }
        out.println(g.getFlow(0, source.size() + sink.size() + 1));
        out.close();
    }

    static int[][] dis;
    static String[] s, t;
    static int n, k;
    static int x, y;

    static void bfs(int x, int y) {
        dis[x][y] = 0;
        Queue<pii> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new pii(x, y));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            x = q.peek().first;
            y = q.peek().second;
            q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int xx = x + dis[i][0];
                int yy = y + dis[i][1];
                if (xx < 0 || xx >= n) continue;
                if (yy < 0 || yy >= n) continue;
                if (dis[xx][yy] != -1) continue;
                if (t[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Y' || t[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Z') continue;
                dis[xx][yy] = dis[x][y] + 1;
                q.add(new pii(xx, yy));
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][] dp;

    static int pos(int t, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (dis[x0][y0] < t) return 0;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return 1;
        if (t >= k) return 0;
        if (dis[x0][y0] <= t) return 0;
        if (dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return dp[t][x0][y0][x][y];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            int xx = x0 + dis[i][0];
            int yy = y0 + dis[i][1];
            if (xx < 0 || xx >= n) continue;
            if (yy < 0 || yy >= n) continue;
            if (s[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Y') continue;
            if (s[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Z') continue;
            if (pos(t + 1, xx, yy, x, y) == 1) return dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
        }
        return dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
    }
}
